items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-cohomological-descent-etale-ph at source lines 1962-1973: for K in D^+(X_etale) with torsion cohomology sheaves the maps pi_X^{-1}K -> R epsilon_{X,*}a_X^{-1}K and K -> R a_{X,*}a_X^{-1}K are isomorphisms. The author's proof at source lines 1975-2005 proves the second statement only (noting the first is easier and identical in method), first reducing from a bounded below complex of torsion sheaves to the case of a single torsion abelian sheaf by representing K by such a complex (a cross-chapter pointer) and applying Leray's acyclicity lemma (a second pointer) to the case of one sheaf, and then proving that case from the two parts of the chapter's comparison lemma (retained as context) together with the relative Leray spectral sequence for a_X = epsilon_X o pi_X, the vanishing of the higher direct images of epsilon_{X,*} on a_X^{-1}F, and the vanishing of R^j pi_{X,*} on pi_X^{-1}F supplied by the chapter's descent lemma (also retained as context). The counted argument is therefore a complete two-stage reduction whose in-chapter ingredients are all available inside the package.
